# Tenacity Business Growth Consultancy

> Business growth consultancy supporting UK small business owners and leaders with coaching, consultancy, project management and facilitation. Founded by Becky Phillips, based in the UK.

- [Coaching](https://www.tenacity.business/services/coaching): One-to-one coaching to build clarity and confidence
- [Consultancy](https://www.tenacity.business/services/consultancy): Expert business guidance for growth
- [Project Management](https://www.tenacity.business/services/project-management): Practical project delivery support
- [Facilitation](https://www.tenacity.business/services/facilitation): Workshops, team days and strategic planning
- [Pricing](https://www.tenacity.business/pricing): Pricing and packages
- [Contact](https://www.tenacity.business/contact): Get in touch or book a discovery call
